word_count_method: Approximate source-word tokens, calculated identically for A/B/C. Expand local input/include files; remove comments, inline/display mathematics, equation/align/verbatim/code environments, citation and cross-reference arguments, EvidenceRef calls, graphic paths and layout arguments. Retain ordinary prose, headings, captions, display notes and table-cell text. Replace ReviewWorkCount by its source-defined number. Count Unicode letter/number sequences with internal apostrophes, hyphens or decimal punctuation as single tokens. This is a consistent approximation, not a formal natural-language word count; source paths/identifiers in visible text can contribute tokens. Abstract counts exclude the root-file keywords.
